_note: Baseline: non-null fk with a matching silver parent. No referential rule fires.

Non-null fk, no parent row. THE case s5.4's CASE lowering handles: CASE WHEN ref.pk IS NULL AND fk IS NOT NULL THEN '__unknown__' ELSE fk END. Under on_missing: quarantine the row diverts instead; under flag it stays with the rule name in _quality_flags. `fail` is deliberately not available (D6).

A NULL fk is NOT an orphan (D19). This row is the correction of Document 5's bare COALESCE(fk, '__unknown__') sketch, which wrongly mapped it to the unknown member. If nulls are invalid here, `not_null` is the rule - not `referential`.
Quoted empty - a non-null empty STRING fk with no parent, so it IS an orphan. Pairs with null_fk to pin the empty-string-vs-null boundary named in s6's dialect list.
The row references itself through parent_order_id. Legal - the referenced row exists. Cycle detection is not a quality rule.
Self-relation fk pointing outside the file. An orphan on the self-join, which is the join a naive LEFT JOIN probe most often gets wrong.

The parent EXISTS in bronze and fails its own rules, so it never reaches silver. The child is an orphan AFTER cleansing, not before - the ordering-sensitive case. s5.1 places `referential` at the bronze->silver row-rule stage reading the referenced SILVER entity, with topological order (RFC 0005) guaranteeing the parent builds first.
Points at fk_to_quarantined_parent, which SURVIVES (only its own fk was rewritten to the unknown member). Proves orphanhood does not cascade.
Padded fk, quoted so the padding survives. Joins are exact, so this is an orphan unless a trim is declared on BOTH sides.
Lowercased fk against an uppercase parent key. Same family as fk_whitespace_variant.

A SOURCE value equal to the reserved member string. After rewriting, this row is indistinguishable from a genuine orphan. D6 accepts this collision for strings because typed per-key sentinels (-1 and friends) collide with LEGAL key values instead, which is worse - the collision is bounded and documented rather than silent.
Half of a two-row cycle. Both parents exist, so no referential rule fires - the cycle is a graph property, not a row property.
The other half of the cycle.
Root of the self-relation: NULL parent_order_id. Must NOT be rewritten to the unknown member (D19), or every root order becomes a fake child.

Self-relation fk to a row that quarantines on its own field rules. Same shape as fk_to_quarantined_parent but WITHIN one entity - the parent lands in this entity's own __reject table, not in a sibling's.

The row fk_to_own_entity_reject points at. Its own amount field is unparseable upstream, so it quarantines - which is what makes that row's parent genuinely absent from silver. Seed this row with a failing field value.
